description:
Thomas & Friends: Let’s Roll invites kids to drive their favorite engines and build their own tracks, fueling big imaginations and tons of hands-on fun. Perfect for preschoolers ages 2-6 and thoughtfully made for all kids to enjoy! 

• Drive around the Island of Sodor to enjoy lots of exciting journeys! 
• You can pick a different engine for each journey, including  Thomas, Bruno, Percy, and more. 
Even very young children can enjoy a rewarding driving experience with our kid-friendly driving controls.
• The TRACK BUILDER feature lets you build a train track and drive a toy train on it! 
• You can enhance your track with lots of fun and interesting scenery options.  
• Watch your trains chug along the track and the landscape you created! 
• This app helps kids develop spatial awareness, fine motor skills, and self-expression. 
 
FUN FOR EVERYONE 
Designed for ALL kids, (especially little neurodivergent engineers) this app brings expert input from autistic writer Jody O'Neill to create a playful, inclusive experience. Kids set their own pace, are offered clear choices, and can safely explore alongside Bruno the Brake Car, a neurodivergent friend from Sodor. Designed for repeated play sessions, this app will offer joy and comfort to kids, over and over again! 

JOURNEYS 
The Old Mine, Whiff’s Recycling Plant, Norramby Beach, McColl’s Farm, and Winter Wonderland 
 
CHARACTERS 
Thomas, Bruno, Gordon, Percy, Nia, Diesel and Kana

FEATURES 
- Safe and age-appropriate
- Designed responsibly to let your child enjoy screen time while developing healthy digital habits at a young age
- Play pre-downloaded content offline without Wi-Fi or internet
- Regular updates with new content
- Apple Family Sharing for easy subscription sharing with other family members
- No third-party advertising
- No in-app purchases for subscribers

SUPPORT
 
For any questions or assistance, please reach out to us at support@storytoys.com.

ABOUT STORYTOYS
 
Our mission is to bring the world's most popular characters, worlds, and stories to life for children. We make apps for kids that engage them in well-rounded activities designed to help them learn, play, and grow. Parents can enjoy peace of mind knowing their kids are learning and having fun at the same time.

PRIVACY & TERMS 
StoryToys takes children's privacy seriously and ensures that its apps comply with privacy laws, including the Child Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA). If you would like to learn more about the information we collect and how we use it, please visit our privacy policy at https://storytoys.com/privacy.
 
Read our terms of use here: https://storytoys.com/terms/

SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS

This app contains sample content that is free to play. However, LOTS MORE fun and entertaining games and activities are available if you purchase a monthly or yearly subscription. While you are subscribed you can play with EVERYTHING. We regularly add new stuff, so subscribed users will enjoy ever-expanding play opportunities.

Google Play does not permit in-app purchases and free apps to be shared via Family Library. Therefore, any purchases you make in this app will NOT be shareable via Family Library.
